Cisco.summary: On October 21, 2026, Node.js announced the availability of fixes for multiple vulnerabilities across the following supported release lines: 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x.  These vulnerabilities impact critical operations such as the Brotli decoder, DNS resolution, and TLS certificate validation.
